integrity: The orbit classification, equality-partition transform, exponent deficits, and asymptotic tail split were reconstructed directly. A standard-library verifier independently enumerates equality partitions, checks the exact transform and collision decomposition, and reproduces A335390 in the graph case.
limitations: The graph-case Stirling transform and its leading asymptotic are prior as OEIS A335390. The retained collision expansion is elementary and therefore has genuine unindexed-folklore priority risk. The finite replay checks identities and convergence but does not replace the asymptotic tail proof.
title: Collision-layer asymptotics for tuple orbits of universal homogeneous hypergraphs
